description: This file contains functions used for managing eMMC partitions, including checking device availability, preparing partitions, formatting, and upgrading firmware on an embedded device. It is part of a firmware upgrade process for a device with eMMC storage, specifically for UDOO platform.

methods.name: udpu_check_emmc
methods.description: Checks for the presence of eMMC device by detecting available block devices and sets the variable 'emmc_dev'.

methods.name: udpu_part_prep
methods.description: Prepares the specified partition by unmounting it if mounted.

methods.name: udpu_do_part_check
methods.description: Verifies the existence of required eMMC partitions and creates a new partition table and formats them if missing.

methods.name: udpu_do_misc_prep
methods.description: Prepares the /misc partition by mounting or reformatting if necessary.

methods.name: udpu_do_initial_setup
methods.description: Formats and sets up essential system partitions (/recovery, /boot, /root) during device initialization.

methods.name: udpu_do_regular_upgrade
methods.description: Performs cleanup and mounts for /boot and /root partitions to prepare for firmware upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_uDPU
methods.description: Coordinates the firmware upgrade process, including calling partition preparations, extracting firmware files, and updating partitions.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_uDPU
methods.description: Handles copying backup configuration files to /misc for persistence across upgrades.
